responsibility: Implements detection and initial construction of Graphite Static Control Parts (SCoPs) from GIMPLE CFG regions. It finds suitable SESE regions, walks dominated basic blocks to collect statements, branch conditions, loop-bound parameters, and data references, builds per-region alias-set groupings for accesses, orders polyhedral basic blocks for schedule creation, filters candidates by structural and parameter limits, and produces the scop objects that seed the rest of the Graphite pipeline. It also contains DOT dumping helpers for visualizing detected SCoPs in the CFG.
